description: Use for Xero questions like "how much working capital do we have in Xero", "where is our cash tied up", "what's our current ratio", "how many days do customers take to pay us", "are we paying suppliers too early", "what changed on the Xero balance sheet this month", or "why is cash down when we made a profit" — even when the user never says "balance sheet". Use when the decision is whether the business can meet its short-term obligations and where cash is sitting. Xero only; for QuickBooks use quickbooks-balance-sheet-and-working-capital.
